claim: Bitstamp documents separate order-entry and matching states: operational means trading and matching are Enabled; a no-matching halt leaves order entry enabled but blocks matching and instant/market orders.
excerpt: Operational: trading: Enabled, matching: Enabled. No-matching halt: trading: Enabled, matching: Disabled.
limitations: Current-state field semantics only; this is not a historical per-market status ledger. The public status response cannot be projected backwards.
